record.t: Appointed his predecessor, Pete Ricketts, to Nebraska's U.S. Senate seat vacated by Ben Sasse.

record.t: Was elected Governor of Nebraska in 2022.
record.q: The governor , a practicing veterinarian and chair of Pillen Family Farms who also played defensive back for the University of Nebraska Cornhuskers football team five decades ago, was first elected in 2022.

record.t: Signed 10 bills into law and announced a veto of one bill.

record.t: Issued two executive orders providing temporary relief to Nebraska farmers, ranchers, and agricultural transporters amid diesel fuel shortages.
record.q: To combat rising diesel fuel shortages and high operating costs during harvest season, Governor Jim Pillen has issued two executive orders providing immediate, temporary relief to Nebraska farmers, ranchers, and agricultural transporters across the state.

record.t: Announced that more than two dozen Nebraska communities are included in the Federal Opportunity Zones Program.
record.q: Today, Governor Jim Pillen announced that more than two dozen rural and urban Nebraska communities will reap the benefits of investment resulting from the new Federal Opportunity Zones Program.
